source_text: Design a compact desktop lifting box. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A compact desktop device with an enclosed lifting mechanism operated manually via a hand crank, capable of raising and lowering an internal platform by approximately 80-100 mm while supporting a payload of approximately 1 kg.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform, with the platform lifting approximately 80-100 mm and supporting a payload of approximately 1 kg.
